title: arabis arenosa subsp. neglecta
intro: Arabis arenosa subsp. neglecta, commonly known as Alpine Rock Cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Arabis arenosa subsp. neglecta include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
